entries.Original: This is often recommended for users having issues while using an installation of RSR with an outdated default configuration. This cannot be undone.
entries.Translated: 这通常建议用户在使用具有过时默认配置的 RSR 安装时遇到问题。这是无法撤销的。

entries.Original: While the RSR team has made an effort to keep RSR compatible with AutoDuty, RSR is not designed with botting in mind.
entries.Translated: 虽然 RSR 团队已经努力保持 RSR 与 AutoDuty 的兼容性，但 RSR 在设计时并没有考虑机器人化。

entries.Original: These are the plugins AutoDuty relies on, and their current state.
entries.Translated: 这些是 AutoDuty 所依赖的插件，以及它们的当前状态。

entries.Original: Both Boss Mods cannot be installed and enabled at the same time. Please disable Boss Mod.
entries.Translated: 两个 Boss 模块无法同时安装和启用。请禁用 Boss 模块。

entries.Original: Please use BossModReborn instead. BMR has specific integration with RSR that improves its ability to react to combat, for example gaze effects.
entries.Translated: 请改用 BossModReborn。BMR 与 RSR 具有特定的集成，可以提高对战斗的反应能力，例如凝视效应。

entries.Original: No trace file yet — enable the tracer and enter combat to create one.
entries.Translated: 还没有追踪文件——启用追踪器并进入战斗创建一个。

entries.Original: Delete every actiontrace_*.log file in the Traces folder and clear the buffered last-frame data.
entries.Translated: 删除 “Traces” 文件夹中的每个 actiontrace_*.log 文件，并清除缓冲的最后一帧数据。

entries.Original: Records the elemental weaknesses (Lightning, Fire, Ice, Wind) observed on hostiles encountered in Occult Crescent, keyed by their NameId. This is populated automatically while in Occult Crescent.
entries.Translated: 记录在超自然新月中遇到的敌人身上观察到的元素弱点 (闪电、火、冰、风)，以他们的 NameId 为键。这些元素在超自然新月中会自动填充。

entries.Translated: 关闭此旋转功能，以防止旋转求解器驱动它。

entries.Original: Enter a search term to filter actions.
entries.Translated: 输入搜索词以过滤操作。

entries.Original: No supporters to display yet. Thank you for checking!
entries.Translated: 目前还没有支持者可以展示。感谢您的查看！

entries.Original: These commands can be used to open or change plugin settings directly from chat or macros.
entries.Translated: 这些命令可以直接从聊天或宏中打开或更改插件设置。

entries.Original: Right-clicking any action, setting or toggle pops up the macro associated with it.
entries.Translated: 右键单击任何操作、设置或切换都会弹出与之相关的宏。

entries.Original: Boss Mod Reborn integration is active.
entries.Translated: Boss Mod Reborn 集成处于活跃状态。

entries.Original: Rotation Solver only drives combat jobs.
entries.Translated: 轮换求解只能解决战斗任务。

entries.Original: You are running the staging branch of Dalamud. For best compatibility, use XIVLauncher and switch back to the release branch when one is available for your game version.
entries.Translated: 你正在运行 Darumud 的中转分支。为了获得最佳兼容性，请使用 XIVLauncher，当你的游戏版本有可用分支时，请切换回发布分支。

entries.Original: You are on an unsupported class:
entries.Translated: 您正处于一个不受支持的课程中：

entries.Original: . Rotation Solver only drives combat jobs.
entries.Translated: 轮换求解器只驱动战斗任务。

entries.Original: Click Details to open plugin compatibility. Right-click the banner to dismiss it.
entries.Translated: 点击 “详细信息” 以打开插件兼容性。右键点击横幅以关闭它。

entries.Original: Right-click to pick a different rotation.
entries.Translated: 右键点击选择不同的旋转。

entries.Original: Headings in this colour mark components added ahead of any caller in the plugin.
entries.Translated: 这个颜色标记组件中的标题在插件中的任何调用者之前添加。

entries.Original: Scales every metric and font below, without touching the text size setting.
entries.Translated: 缩放下方的每个度量和字体，而不触碰文本大小设置。

entries.Original: The saved interface accent colour. The whole scheme is derived from it.
entries.Translated: 保存的界面重点颜色。整个方案都源于此。

entries.Original: Clears every eased value and cached card height, as closing the window does.
entries.Translated: 清除所有缓冲值和缓存卡高度，就像关闭窗口一样。

entries.Original: Click a swatch to copy its hex value.
entries.Translated: 点击单击以拷贝其十六进制值。

entries.Original: Flip to send both dots across.
entries.Translated: 翻转以将两个点都发送过去。

entries.Original: Standard, filled, tonal, outlined and danger styles; the first two swap glyphs as well.
entries.Translated: 标准、填充、色调、轮廓和危险风格;前两个交换字形也包括在内。

entries.Original: The controls of a window without a title bar. Over a plain surface, pass a container fill.
entries.Translated: 没有标题栏的窗口控件。在平面上传递容器填充。

entries.Original: With a minimize button, the bar folds into a brand, as the settings window does.
entries.Translated: 使用最小化按钮，条形图会像设置窗口一样折叠成一个品牌。

entries.Original: Supporting text says what the setting does.
entries.Translated: 支持文本说明了设置的功能。

entries.Original: A bare radio button; the caller owns its state.
entries.Translated: 一个裸露的无线电按钮;呼叫者拥有自己的状态。

entries.Original: Click the body, or the cross to remove
entries.Translated: 点击身体或十字架以移除

entries.Original: Matches any enemy whose name contains this text.
entries.Translated: 匹配任何名称包含此文本的敌人。

entries.Original: The tick marks a threshold, here 75%.
entries.Translated: 刻度标记了一个阈值，在这里是 75%。

entries.Original: Determinate ones follow the slider above.
entries.Translated: 按照上述滑块进行确定。

entries.Original: Shown along the bottom of this window, one at a time. Hovering one holds it on screen.
entries.Translated: 沿着这个窗口的底部显示，一次一个。悬停其中一个窗口，将其保持在屏幕上。

entries.Original: A longer snackbar wraps onto a second line when it will not fit on one, and stays up for the long duration.
entries.Translated: 一个较长的小吃吧在无法放入第一排时会卷入第二排，并在较长时间内保持不变。

entries.Original: Download the rotations for your job, or point Rotation Solver at a local folder.
entries.Translated: 下载你工作的轮岗信息，或者将轮岗求解器指向本地文件夹。

entries.Original: Tooltips drawn through ImguiTooltips honour the Show tooltips setting.
entries.Translated: 通过 ImguiTooltips 绘制的工具提示符合 Show 工具提示设置。

entries.Original: A dialog without a hero icon keeps its headline leading-aligned. Escape dismisses it.
entries.Translated: 一个没有英雄图标的对话会使其标题保持引人注目的对齐。Escape 则会将其忽略。

entries.Original: A subtitle wraps under the title.
Card content is inset from the accent rail, and wrapped text stops at the card's padding.
entries.Translated: 卡片内容从重音轨插入，包裹的文本在卡片衬里处停止。

entries.Original: Supporting text wraps beneath the headline.
entries.Translated: 支持文本包含在标题下方。

entries.Original: Label, icon and control all dim.
entries.Translated: 标签、图标和控件都变暗了。

entries.Original: Struck-through row: hidden by a job filter, kept in place so the list does not reflow
entries.Translated: 擦除行：被作业过滤器隐藏，保持在原位，以防止列表重新流动

entries.Original: The whole row is one target.
Dependent settings indent under it while it is on.
entries.Translated: 打开时，相关设置会在其下方缩进。

entries.Original: Action icons need the current job's rotation.
entries.Translated: 动作图标需要旋转当前任务。

entries.Original: With cooldowns and charges, when the rotation's actions have them:
entries.Translated: 使用冷却和负载时，当轮换的动作具有这些特性时：

entries.Original: The drawer collapses to the rail below
entries.Translated: 抽屉坍塌到下面的栏杆上
dp. 两者共享一个选择。

entries.Original: The page switcher at the top of this gallery is a primary tab row too.
entries.Translated: 这个画廊顶部的页面切换器也是主要的标签行。

entries.Original: Secondary tabs, for a second level under primary ones.
entries.Translated: 次要标签，用于主要标签之下的第二级。

entries.Original: Right-click for the matching chat commands.
entries.Translated: 右键点击匹配的聊天命令。

entries.Original: Right-click for the matching chat command.
entries.Translated: 右键点击匹配的聊天命令。

entries.Original: Hide the timeline. Turn it back on in the UI settings.
entries.Translated: 隐藏时间线。在 UI 设置中将其重新打开。

entries.Original: Actions show up here as you use them.
entries.Translated: 操作会在你使用时显示在这里。

entries.Original: Locked in place. Click to allow moving and resizing.
entries.Translated: 锁定。点击以允许移动和调整大小。

entries.Original: Hide the Control window. Turn it back on in the UI settings.
entries.Translated: 隐藏 “控制” 窗口。在 UI 设置中将其重新打开。

entries.RoleReason: 既进 UI（ImGui.CalcTextSize）又进功能语境（返回值）

entries.Original: Allow the rotation to spend its burst cooldowns.
entries.Translated: 允许轮换消耗其爆发冷却时间。

entries.Original: How Auto mode picks its target. Click to choose from your targeting list.
entries.Translated: 自动模式如何选择其目标。点击以从目标列表中选择。

entries.Original: Do not use any AoE actions.
entries.Translated: 不要使用任何 AoE 操作。
仅使用单目标 AoE 操作。
使用所有可用的 AoE 操作。

entries.Original: You are X. Click to play.
I made this because i was bored
entries.Translated: 我做这个是因为我很无聊。

entries.Original: Rotation Solver Reborn (RSR) reads the fight every frame, works out the best next action for your job, and either displays it or performs it. This tour covers the essentials in about five minutes. (Reading comprehension required)
entries.Translated: 旋转求解器重生 (RSR) 会在每一帧中解读战斗，为你的工作制定最佳的下一步行动，并显示或执行它。本导览将在大约 5 分钟内涵盖基本内容。(需要阅读理解)

entries.Original: Every RSR window takes its colours from a single accent colour. Pick one you like and set the text and element sizes; this tour updates as you go.
entries.Translated: 每个 RSR 窗口都采用单一的强调色。选择一个你喜欢的，并设置文字和元素大小;这个导览会随着你的操作而更新。

entries.Original: RSR is always in one of a few modes. It does nothing until autorotation is activaed, and it can switch itself off again after combat.
entries.Translated: RSR 始终处于少数几种模式之一。在自动旋转激活之前，它什么也不做，并且在战斗结束后可以再次自动关闭。

entries.Original: Type /rotation (or /rsr) in chat to open the settings. Here is how the window is laid out.
entries.Translated: 在聊天中键入/rotation(或/rsr) 以打开设置。以下是窗口的布局。

entries.Original: Each combat job has one or more rotations to choose from. Rotations called 'Reborn' or 'Evolved' (Starting with Evercold) are the default rotations, other rotations are designed by not-me and are not tested, your milage may vary.
entries.Translated: 每个战斗任务都有一个或多个轮岗选择。被称为 “重生” 或 “进化”(从 Evercold 开始) 的轮岗是默认轮岗，其他轮岗由非我设计且未经测试，你的里程数可能会有所不同。

entries.Original: Every action your rotation can use, grouped by type. Switch any of them off, or change when they are allowed to fire.
entries.Translated: 你的旋转可以使用的每个动作，按类型分组。关闭其中任何一个，或者在允许发射时进行更改。

entries.Original: Behaviour shared by every job: how freely to use AoE, when RSR switches itself on and off, healing thresholds and more.
entries.Translated: 每个工作都有一些共同的行为：如何自由使用 AoE，当 RSR 自动开关时，治愈阈值等等。

entries.Original: Which enemies RSR will attack in Auto, and the order it picks them in.
entries.Translated: RSR 将在 Auto 中攻击哪些敌人，以及它选择敌人的顺序。

entries.Original: Optional windows that show what RSR is doing, and teaching mode, which lights up the next action on your hotbars.
entries.Translated: 可选的窗口显示 RSR 正在进行的操作，以及教学模式，该模式会点亮你热狗上的下一个操作。

entries.Original: Curated lists that tell every job how to react to particular statuses and actions, plus switches for particular kinds of content.
entries.Translated: 精心设计的清单，告诉每份工作如何对特定状态和行动做出反应，还有针对特定类型内容的开关。

entries.Original: Timing, events and backups. The defaults suit most players, so come back here once you are comfortable.
entries.Translated: 时间、事件和备份。默认设置适合大多数玩家，所以等你感觉舒服了再来这里吧。

entries.Original: Everything in RSR can be driven from chat, which means it can live on your hotbar. Here are three macros to start with.
entries.Translated: RSR 中的一切都可以通过聊天来驱动，这意味着它可以存活在你的 Hot Bar 上。这里有三个宏可以作为开始。

entries.Original: That's the essentials. RSR stays off until you turn it on, so nothing will happen until you are ready.
entries.Translated: 这是关键。RSR 在你打开之前会保持关闭状态，所以在你准备好之前，什么都不会发生。
欢迎来到旋转求解器重生

entries.Original: Opens the settings window on this page. The tutorial stays open.
entries.Translated: 在此页面打开设置窗口。教程保持打开状态。

entries.Original: Close the tutorial. Reopen it any time from the About page.
entries.Translated: 关闭教程。随时从 “关于” 页面重新打开。

entries.Original: Your gauge, buffs, cooldowns and party HP, plus every enemy nearby, checked many times a second.
entries.Translated: 你的计量表、BUFF、冷却时间和团队 HP，再加上附近的每个敌人，每秒钟都要检查多次。

entries.Original: Your job's rotation decides what comes next: GCDs and weaves, heals, mitigation, interrupts and more.
entries.Translated: 你工作的轮换决定了接下来会发生什么:GCD 和编织、治愈、缓解、中断等等。

entries.Original: Switched on, RSR presses the action itself. Teaching mode lights it up on your hotbar too, so you can follow along.
entries.Translated: 打开后，RSR 会自动点击操作。教学模式也会在你的热狗上点亮它，这样你就可以跟上进度。

entries.Original: Settings shown in this tour can be changed right here, and apply straight away. Jump between steps with the list on the left, and close the tour whenever you like; the About page can reopen it.
entries.Translated: 您可以在此处更改本导览中显示的设置，并立即应用。使用左侧的列表在步骤之间跳转，随时关闭导览;关于页面可以重新打开。

entries.Original: Prints each setting's explanation under its name. Turn it off for a denser list; the explanation stays in the tooltip.
entries.Translated: 在每个设置的名称下打印其说明。关闭以显示更密集的列表;说明保留在工具提示中。

entries.Original: A banner above each settings page that cycles through usage tips.
entries.Translated: 每个设置页面上方的横幅循环显示使用提示。

entries.Original: Puts the accent colour, text size and element size back to how they started.
entries.Translated: 将重音颜色、文字大小和元素大小恢复到它们最初的样子。

entries.Original: All of these are on the UI page too, next to the colours for teaching mode and the hotbar highlights.
entries.Translated: 所有这些都在用户界面页面上，旁边是教学模式的颜色和热棒突出显示。

entries.Original: Auto activates the autorotation algorithm and allows RSR to set targets for you based on the next calculated action. Run /rotation Auto again to step to the next targeting rule.
entries.Translated: Auto 激活自动旋转算法，并允许 RSR 根据下一个计算动作为您设置目标。再次运行/旋转 Auto 以进入下一个瞄准规则。

entries.Original: Manual activate the autorotation algorithm but does not allow RSR to set targets and locks the hostile target list to only the selected target. Party healing is still possible on Manual mode as RSR uses soft targeting for that.
entries.Translated: 手动激活自动旋转算法，但不允许 RSR 设置目标，并且只将敌对目标列表锁定到选定的目标。在手动模式下，队友治疗仍然可能，因为 RSR 使用软目标进行治疗。

entries.Original: RSR chooses targets as in Auto but never uses an action. Every button press is yours.
entries.Translated: RSR 像自动模式一样选择目标，但从不使用动作。每次按键都是你自己的。

entries.Original: Nothing is targeted or used. Turn RSR off whenever you are not using it.
entries.Translated: 没有任何东西是针对性的或被使用的。在不使用时关闭 RSR。

entries.Original: Different ways to control RSR autorotation states
entries.Translated: 控制 RSR 自转状态的不同方式

entries.Original: RSR can switch itself on when a countdown starts, and off again after combat, when you die or when a duty ends. That is set up in the Auto step.
entries.Translated: RSR 可以在倒计时开始时自动打开，战斗结束后，当你死亡或任务结束时再次关闭。这是在自动步骤中设置的。

entries.Original: Every settings page is listed down the left in a scrollable list.
entries.Translated: 每个设置页面都在左下角的滚动列表中列出。

entries.Original: The search field above the page list finds any setting by name, and each result links to the page it lives on.
entries.Translated: 页面列表上方的搜索栏按名称查找任何设置，每个结果都会链接到其所在的页面。

entries.Original: Your current job (as a deep dungeon pixelart icon) and the loaded rotation. Click it to configure the rotation; right-click it to switch to another.
entries.Translated: 您当前的工作 (作为深层地下城的像素图标) 和加载的旋转。点击它以配置旋转;右键点击它以切换到另一个。

entries.Original: Banners across the top of each page flag problems, such as a conflicting plugin, and cycle through tips.
entries.Translated: 横跨每个页面顶部的横幅标记问题，例如相互冲突的插件，并循环显示提示。

entries.Original: Right-click any setting, toggle or action to see the chat command that changes it, ready to copy.
entries.Translated: 右键单击任何设置、切换或操作，查看改变它的 chat 命令，准备复制。

entries.Original: The chip at the bottom of the page list copies a report for support. It pulses red while a plugin known to crash RSR is enabled.
entries.Translated: 页面列表底部的芯片复制了一份报告以获得支持。当一个已知会崩溃的 RSR 插件被激活时，它会闪烁红色。

entries.Original: The skull button at the top right of the settings window resets every RSR setting. It asks first, but there is no undo, so back up from the Extra page before trying it.
entries.Translated: 设置窗口右上方的骷髅头按钮会重置所有 RSR 设置。它会先询问，但没有取消功能，所以在尝试之前请先退出 “额外” 页面。

entries.Original: You are on a crafting or gathering job. Rotation Solver only drives combat jobs, so switch to one to see its rotation here.
entries.Translated: 你正在进行生产或采集任务。旋转求解器只能执行战斗任务，所以切换到一个任务，在这里查看它的旋转。

entries.Original: Pick another rotation for this job.
entries.Translated: 为这份工作选择另一个轮换。

entries.Original: Click any icon to open its settings alongside. The small tick or cross on each icon shows whether it is enabled.
entries.Translated: 点击任何图标以打开其旁边的设置。每个图标上的小刻度或十字表示是否已启用。

entries.Original: RSR never uses a disabled action. You can still press it yourself.
entries.Translated: RSR 从不使用禁用操作。你仍然可以自己点击它。

entries.Original: Depending on the action: a time-to-kill threshold, an HP threshold for heals, how many targets an AoE needs, and whether it shows in the cooldown window.
entries.Translated: 取决于行动：击杀时间阈值、治疗 HP 阈值、AOE 需要多少目标，以及它是否显示在冷却时间窗口中。

entries.Original: When RSR switches itself on and off.
entries.Translated: 当 RSR 自动开关时。

entries.Original: Switches on as soon as a pull timer begins, so the rotation can time its pre-pull actions.

attributes.Original:
Please note that this rotation is optimised for most fights. However, V&C/OC GCDs may break mudra.
• Standard 4th GCD is the highest adps damage opener; other options trade personal damage for rdps
• Please start fights from flank, or True North may disrupt weaving
• Use rotation Settings AutoBurst False AT LEAST 5 seconds BEFORE Kassatsu ready to delay burst
• Use rotation Settings AutoBurst True to resume burst or toggle via macro
• You must stay close for Kunai's Bane before suiton buff expires
• Intercept Forked Raiju manually if desired
• Use ac Shukuchi gtoff macro for movement

Rotation behaviour (compared to Reborn):
• Uses layered ninjutsu priority (burst prep → disengage → damage)
• Adds early burst preparation (Suiton/Huton) based on burst action cooldown timing
• Includes distance-based disengage uptime (Raiton/Katon)
• Reserving mudra only for burst or uptime
• Customizable Opener and Potion Usage
• Burst delay optimization: only do fillers and prevent mudra cap when delaying. when renable burst (Huton/Suiton - Kassatsu - Dokumori - Kunai's Bane - TCJ)
• Uses explicit AoE target counting for actions around targets/self
attributes.Translated:
请注意，这种轮换对大多数比赛都是优化的。然而，V&C/OC GCD 可能会打破手印。
• 标准第四 GCD 是最高的应用程序伤害开关;其他选项用个人伤害换取 RDP
• 请从侧翼开始战斗，否则 True North 可能会干扰编织
• 使用旋转设置 自动爆发假设 在 Kassatsu 准备好延迟爆发前 5 秒
• 使用旋转设置 AutoBurst True 通过宏恢复突发或切换
• 你必须紧跟 Kunai 的 Bane，直到 Suitonbuff 过期。
• 如果需要，可以手动拦截分叉莱珠
• 使用 ac Shukuchi gtoff 宏进行运动

旋转行为 (与重生相比):
• 使用分层忍术优先级 (爆发准备→断开连接→损坏)
• 根据突发行动冷却时间添加早期爆发准备 (Suiton/Huton)
• 包括基于距离的离线时间 (Rayton/Katon)
• 仅为爆发或正常运行时间预留手印
• 自定义开瓶器和药剂使用
• 爆发延迟优化：仅在延迟时进行填充并防止泥浆盖。当可恢复爆发时 (Huton/Suiton - Kassatsu - Takumori - Kunai‘s Bane - TCJ)

M8S——狼包/石包逻辑。

attributes.Original: Treat Wolf of Wind/Wolf of Stone as immune if you don't have the corresponding status for it.
attributes.Translated: 如果你没有相应的地位，请将风之狼/石之狼视为免疫者。
M9S——仅使用切割逻辑。

attributes.Original: This should clear up any targeting issues when a nail, the boss, and a flail are near each other at the same time.

M9S——细胞靶向逻辑。

attributes.Original: Treat Cells as immune if you don't have the corresponding status for it.
attributes.Translated: 如果细胞没有相应的免疫状态，请将其视为免疫细胞。
M9S——广告定位逻辑。

无限蓝极——鲸鱼逻辑。

attributes.Original: Treat Bismark Shell/Bismark Corona as immune if you don't have the Whaleback status
attributes.Translated: 如果您没有鲸鱼背状态，请将 Bismark Shell/Bismark Corona 视为免疫

attributes.Original: Cinder Drift Extreme - Pall Targeting logic.

attributes.Original: Treat Pall of Rage/Pall of Grief as immune if you don't have the corresponding status for it.
attributes.Translated: 如果你没有相应的状态，就把愤怒的帕尔/悲伤的帕尔当作免疫的。
解构极端——阴影逻辑。

attributes.Original: Treat Shadow as immune if you don't have the corresponding status
attributes.Translated: 如果影子没有相应的状态，请将其视为免疫

attributes.Original: The Epic of Alexander (Ultimate) - Jagd Doll logic.

attributes.Original: The Omega Protocol (Ultimate) - Packet Filter logic.

attributes.Original: Treat OmegaM/OmegaF as immune if you have their corresponding Packet Filter status.
attributes.Translated: 如果 OmegaM/OmegaF 具有相应的数据包过滤器状态，则将其视为免疫。

attributes.Original: Futures Rewritten (Ultimate) - Crystal Of Darkness logic.

attributes.Translated: 将黑暗水晶视为免疫力的广告。
狂舞 (终极)——英雄/反派逻辑。

attributes.Original: Treat bosses as immune if you don't have the corresponding status for it.
attributes.Translated: 如果你没有相应的地位，就把老板当作免疫者对待。

attributes.Original: The Ghimlyt Dark - Colossus Rubricatus ad.
attributes.Translated: 吉姆利特·达克——巨人鲁布里卡图斯的广告。

attributes.Translated: 将巨人鲁布里卡特斯视为免疫者，而它的角色扮演则是导致其死亡的脚本化行为。
多恩·梅赫——说谎者莱尔的机械。

attributes.Translated: 如果你没有未被愚弄的状态，请将说谎者莱尔视为免疫者。

attributes.Original: Treat Jailers in second boss fight as immune if you don't have corresponding buff.
attributes.Translated: 如果你没有相应的 BUFF，就把第二个 BOSS 中的狱卒当作免疫者来对待。

attributes.Translated: 如果你没有对应的特里同/涅瑞伊德/火卫一状态，请将其视为免疫。

attributes.Translated: 分叉塔魔法——第一个 BOSS 维利安/英雄。

attributes.Original: Treat the first boss of Forked Tower as immune if you don't have the corresponding status for it.
attributes.Translated: 如果你没有相应的地位，可以将叉塔的第一个 boss 视为免疫者。

attributes.Original: North Horn CE - Tiny Mage targetting logic.

attributes.Translated: 如果你距离小魔法师 CE 群超过 5 码，而且他们不是最远的，那就当他们是免疫的。
元素弱点追踪。

attributes.Original: Enable tracking of elemental weaknesses for debug. This enables you to track weaknesses to report to dev. See Debug > Occult Crescent Weaknesses.
attributes.Translated: 允许跟踪基本弱点进行调试。这使您能够跟踪弱点并向开发人员报告。请参阅 “调试”>“隐藏的新月弱点”。
朝圣者之路——杰出的悲伤逻辑。

attributes.Original: Treat Eminent Grief as immune if you don't have Light Vengeance buff, and treat Devoured Eater as immune if you don't have Dark Vengeance buff.
attributes.Translated: 如果您没有光明复仇 buff，请将卓越悲伤视为免疫;如果您没有黑暗复仇 buff，请将被吞噬者视为免疫。

attributes.Original: The Labyrinth of the Ancients - Thanatos logic.
attributes.Translated: 古人的迷宫——塔纳托斯的逻辑。

attributes.Original: Treat Thanatos as immune if you don't have Astral Realignment buff.
attributes.Translated: 如果你没有星光重新校准 buff，请将死神视为免疫者。

attributes.Original: The Void Ark - Irminsul and Sawtooth logic.
attributes.Translated: 虚空方舟——伊尔明苏尔和锯齿逻辑。

attributes.Original: Treat Irminsul and Sawtooth as immune if you don't have corresponding buff.
attributes.Translated: 如果没有相应的 buff，请将 Irminsul 和 Sawtooth 视为免疫者。

attributes.Original: The Puppets' Bunker - Superior Flight Unit logic.
attributes.Translated: 玩偶地堡——高级飞行单位逻辑。

attributes.Original: Treat each Superior Flight Unit as immune if you don't have corresponding buff.
attributes.Translated: 如果没有相应的 BUFF，请将每个优秀飞行单位视为免疫。

attributes.Translated: 范式突破的塔——糖果屋和葛蕾特的逻辑。

attributes.Original: Treat each Hansel/Gretel as immune if you are at an angle that would cause you to take rebound damage from the shield mechanic.
attributes.Translated: 如果你所处的角度会导致你受到来自盾牌机械师的反弹伤害，那就把每个 Hansel/Gretel 都当作免疫的。

attributes.Original: Jeuno: The First Walk - The Ark Angels logic.
attributes.Translated: 《饥饿：第一次行走》——方舟天使的逻辑。

attributes.Original: Treat each Ark Angel as immune if you don't have corresponding buff.
attributes.Translated: 如果没有相应的 BUFF，请将每个方舟天使视为免疫的。

attributes.Original: Windurst: The Third Walk - Alexander Resurrected logic.
attributes.Translated: 温德尔斯特：第三次散步——亚历山大复活的逻辑。

attributes.Original: Treat Alexander and/or Gordius Systems as immune if they have Perfect Defense.
attributes.Translated: 如果亚历山大和/或戈尔迪乌斯系统拥有完美防御，就将其视为免疫系统。

attributes.Translated: 如果没有相应的 BUFF，请将黑暗之云/冥河视为免疫。

attributes.Translated: 希尔迪恩地下城——德雷克家族广告逻辑。

attributes.Original: Custom logic to treat certain drakes as immune to kill them in a specific order for the purposes Variant path 12.
attributes.Translated: 自定义逻辑将某些龙视为具有免疫力，以特定顺序杀死它们，用于特定目的 Variant path 12。
《宝藏地下城》——定时黑帮逻辑。

attributes.Original: Priotizes limited time mobs in treasure dungeons to resolve extra loot mechanic.
attributes.Translated: 优先考虑宝藏地牢中的有限时间小怪，以解决额外的掠夺机制。
《宝藏地下城》——编号黑帮逻辑。

attributes.Original: Sets mobs with number plates as top priority in order from lowest to highest to resolve extra loot mechanic.
attributes.Translated: 将拥有号码牌的小怪设置为最高优先级，从低到高排序，以解决额外的抢劫机制。
为了 PvP 目的忽略 TTK。

attributes.Translated: 在 Shatter 中优先考虑一层 tomeliths。

attributes.Translated: 在 Shatter 中优先考虑 B 级托梅利斯。
无视 PvP 目的的无敌性。

attributes.Original: Auto turn off when dead in PvP.
attributes.Translated: 在 PvP 中死亡时自动关闭。

attributes.Original: Auto turn off when PvP match ends.
attributes.Translated: 当 PvP 匹配结束时，自动关闭。

attributes.Translated: 使用 BMR 集成来验证运动行为/导致被截获使用的运动的安全性。(实验性)

attributes.Original: Intercept player input and queue it for RSR to execute the action. (PvE only)
attributes.Translated: 拦截玩家输入并将其排队等待 RSR 执行操作。(仅限 PvE)

attributes.Translated: 当启用并加载 BossModReborn 时，RSR 将允许 BMR 的冷却计划器中计划的行动在其窗口处于活动状态时通过拦截系统。

attributes.Translated: 在切换场景时自动关闭战斗状态。

attributes.Translated: 当插件更新时，显示带有变更日志的弹出窗口。

attributes.Original: Show plugin status in DTR bar.
attributes.Translated: 在 DTR 栏中显示插件状态。

attributes.Original: Display the plugin's current status in the server information bar.
attributes.Translated: 在服务器信息栏中显示插件的当前状态。

attributes.Original: Display plugin status in toast popup
attributes.Translated: 在 Toast 弹出窗口中显示插件状态

attributes.Original: Show a toast notification with the combat state when changed.
attributes.Translated: 当战斗状态发生变化时，显示祝酒通知。

attributes.Original: Lock movement when casting or performing certain actions.
attributes.Translated: 在施放或执行某些动作时锁定动作。

attributes.Translated: 防止角色在施法或使用特定动作时移动。

attributes.Translated: 在 AOE 缓解期间施放《武器之路》时的锁定操作。

attributes.Translated: 在 AOE 缓解期间施加集体潜意识时锁定操作。

attributes.Original: Lock actions when casting Phantom Flurry.
attributes.Translated: 施展 Phantom Flurry 时的锁定操作。

attributes.Translated: 此设置仅在旋转特别支持自动酊剂使用时才使用。

attributes.Translated: 自动使用防击退角色操作 (Arms Length, Surecast)

attributes.Original: Enable to automatically use anti-knockback abilities when needed based on anti-knockback action list in List menu.
attributes.Translated: 根据 “列表” 菜单中的反击退操作列表，在需要时自动使用击退功能。

attributes.Translated: 允许插件自动使用 MP 药剂。

attributes.Translated: 在 “下一步行动” 窗口中显示目标提示

attributes.Translated: 当教学模式处于活动状态时，在 “下一步行动” 图标下方显示旋转的建议目标名称。如果未选择该目标，则显示为橙色;如果选择了该目标，则显示为绿色。

attributes.Original: Simulate the effect of pressing abilities

attributes.Translated: 倒计时开始时激活自动模式

attributes.Translated: 如果倒计时期间战斗提前开始，请取消自动模式

attributes.Translated: 当遭受攻击时，自动切换到手动模式。

attributes.Translated: 在博兹亚/尤里卡/神秘命运/CE 作战时自动切换至自动模式

attributes.Original:
1.    Self-Target Fallback:
If range is zero, always targets the player and returns all affectable targets at the player's position.
2.    Preferred Positions (OnLocations):
•    Tries to get predefined beneficial positions for the current territory.
•    If none are found and the content is a trial or raid, uses fallback points (e.g., 0,0 or 100,100 point as those are the center of arenas most of the time).
•    Picks the closest point to the player, applies a small random offset, and checks if it’s within effect range.
•    If so, returns that as the target area.
3.    Boss Positional Fallback:
•    If the current target is a boss with positional requirements and within range, uses the boss’s position (or a point within range) as the target area.
4.    Party Member Fallback:
•    Gathers party members within range + effect range.
•    Attempts to find a party member who is being attacked (tank or focus target).
•    If found, calculates whether to stay at the player’s position or move closer to the tank, based on distances and effect range.
•    If not found or not needed, defaults to the player’s position.
attributes.Translated:
1. 自我目标回撤：
如果射程为零，则始终瞄准玩家，并在玩家位置返回所有受影响的目标。
2. 首选位置 (OnLocations):
• 试图为当前领土获得预定义的有利位置。
• 如果没有发现任何内容，且内容是试炼或突袭，则使用备用点数 (例如，0、0 或 100、100 个点数，因为这些点数通常是竞技场的中心)。
• 选择离玩家最近的点，应用一个小的随机偏移，并检查它是否在效果范围内。
• 如果是，返回该区域作为目标区域。
3.Boss 位置回撤：
• 如果当前目标是具有位置要求且在范围内的 boss，则以 boss 的位置 (或范围内的一个点) 作为目标区域。
4. 队员后备：
• 在范围 + 效果范围内聚集党员。
• 试图找到正在遭受攻击的党员 (坦克或聚焦目标)。
• 如果发现，根据距离和效果范围计算是保持玩家位置还是移动到更靠近坦克的位置。
• 如果未找到或不需要，则默认为玩家的位置。

attributes.Original: Controls how much party members' HP must differ before using AoE healing instead of single-target heals. Lower values require party members to have more similar HP for AoE healing to trigger (more selective). Higher values allow AoE healing even when HP differences are larger (less selective). Adjust only if you want to fine-tune AoE heal behavior.
attributes.Translated: 控制队伍成员在使用 AoE 治疗之前的 HP 差异程度，而不是使用单目标治疗。较低的值需要队伍成员具有更相似的 HP 才能触发 AoE 治疗 (更具选择性)。较高的值允许 AoE 治疗，即使 HP 差异较大 (选择性较低)。仅在需要微调 AoE 治疗行为时进行调整。

attributes.Original: Configures the maximum simulated delay in milliseconds when using animation lock removal - this is required and cannot be reduced to zero. Setting this to 20ms will enable triple-weaving when using autorotation. The minimum setting to remove triple-weaving is 26ms. The minimum of 20ms has been accepted by FFLogs and should not cause issues with your logs.
